newsitem.title: FRANCE: France aims to change pension fund tax treatment.
newsitem.headline: France aims to change pension fund tax treatment.

text.p: The French government wants to modify a law introducing pension funds to France to change the tax treatment of company contributions to the funds, Christian Sautter, junior minister responsible for the budget, said on Wednesday.

"The principle of personal pension funds in addition to the pay-as-you go system is not being called into question. But we are looking for neutrality between the universal pay-as-you-go system and private pension funds from a fiscal point of view," Sautter said.

Sautter said the government was worried that companies would favour contributions to private pension funds over salaries because of favourable tax treatment under the pension fund law of the previous centre-right government.
